INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

2. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.

3. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

5. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

9. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

10. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
